messages.subject: Re: How to install RApache on windows
messages.subject_clean: How to install RApache on windows
messages.body_plain:
I've just install virtual Linux machine (Oracle Virtual Box)  with bridged network card to play with rApache. It is the easiest and safest way if you do not know Linux. Or you want to test something. All you can do wrong is virtual ;)
I do not know wheter it will work with Cygwin environment... Personally I prefer virtual machine if I need acces to both Windows and other systems.
After all, if you do not need two running simltaneously systems you can install Linux either on separate removable disk or on pendrive.

Regards, Magdalena
